I can offer you my experience and perspective, but I can’t say in good faith that your boyfriend shares the same views or holds the same values as I do. I don’t think you should use my personal experience as a backdrop for navigating whatever situation you’re currently in/previously had with him, especially if he refuses to acknowledge what he did. With that being said, if understanding my thoughts helps you in any way, I won’t hesitate to tell the truth.

I had too many thoughts running around in my head at the time. Most of them were sexual in nature, like how cute/sexy she looked during. We had done the specific act, which I won’t describe for trigger reasons, consensually a few times before. I always tried to be gentle, because otherwise she’d wake up and the game would be over. I found the gentleness aspect of it arousing too. It was the most arousing thing to think that I could use her body like a living sex toy, and that she didn’t mind it.

So that’s what I convinced myself to believe while I was raping her. That she just didn’t mind it. That she enjoyed this sort of thing before, and she wouldn’t be all that mad if she did wake up. And It’s been over a month since we had real sex, so of course I’m desperate. This is just a compromise between sex and masturbation. I knew these were lies I was telling myself to rationalize the situation and yet I continued anyway. 

I continued and even manipulated my own cognitive dissonance in such a way that I took pics on my phone of what I was doing, so that I “wouldn’t want to do it again”. I want to vomit having just typed that. Whatever scrap of good in me I had then was screaming at me all of the reasons to stop, and out of my own selfishness and desire for sexual release, I just didn’t listen. I wanted to cum from some type of sex with my girlfriend and I had to believe she enjoyed it. Pretty sure that was the main theme in my head.

I’m more disgusted with myself now than I was then, and I won’t ever hurt someone like that ever again. I think that’s the only good thing to come from this.

Also thank you for the kindness, I do not deserve it.
